name: io.github.thevrus/marklayer
title: MarkLayer
description: Work visual annotations left on a live webpage: watch, acknowledge, resolve, reply.

packageArguments.name: --room
packageArguments.description: MarkLayer room to join at startup: a share URL (https://marklayer.app/s/abc123) or a bare room id. Omit it and the agent calls marklayer_connect_room instead.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_ROOM
environmentVariables.description: Same as --room: the share URL or room id to join at startup.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the MarkLayer worker base URL. Defaults to https://marklayer.app; useful against a local dev worker.

environmentVariables.name: MARKLAYER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Name shown to the humans in the room for this agent. Defaults to claude-code.
